description: Explain a Zalo error code in plain words: which table it comes from (ZBS Template Message, the archived ZNS table, or the Official Account API; the same code can mean different things in different tables) and what to check. A positive number is also tried as negative. Examples: {"code":-133}; {"code":-100,"table":"oa_api"}; {"code":249}.

code.description: Error code returned by Zalo, e.g. -133 (a positive number is also tried as negative).

table.description: Limit to one table: zbs (ZBS Template Message), zns_archive (old ZNS), oa_api (Official Account API).

name: error_lookup
title: Zalo error code lookup
